answer_prose: Pace retention showed a correlation of 0.41 across consecutive recorded races one calendar year apart, and 0.32 three years apart. There is persistence, but a runner’s earlier pacing pattern is not destiny.
detail_prose: Persistence may reflect the runner, repeated course choices, or shared conditions. It is not an immutable pacing personality.
